sources.title: Exact hidden-state, support, option-clock and planning-horizon witnesses
sources.author: Causal banking proposal project
supported_claims: Prior1/4 and declared sensor give posteriors1/2 and1/10; stipulated signal-policy net7/4 versus-13/4 under an uninformative actual sensor.
Three-stage depth-powered discount gives13/8 versus ordinary7/4; option clock gives15 versus11.
Weighted repeated-state query gives1/2 versus sampling2/3; ordinary unweighted frequency is2/3.
Impossible observation gives zero normalizer; restricted next-state support changes conditional mass.
Zero duration leaves rollout depth unchanged; source checks outer budget between simulations.
